track.name: Race Days 2026 - Heathrow
track.author: Antti Koskinen
track.notes: Lift Foils Race Days track layout offers a a simple, yet interesting line where your carving technique is put to the test, with a long left side turn around buoys 4-5-6 where top speed counts.

startTechnique.timetrial: Flying start, crossing the timing line starts the lap.
startTechnique.notes: Each rider gets three laps, which will be *done in one run* so you can find your flow. Start slow, faster on the second and push on the third!

track.name: Nice France - Draft B
track.author: A. Koskinen
track.notes:
A really long and technical track, just to play with what might be possible.

A 1 vs 1 heat would be like the classic 1/2 lap offset at track midpoint.

Would this be interesting to spectators? Would this be fun for riders? Super technical near the beach, fast sections outside.

track.name: Nice France - Draft A
track.notes: Official Speedtrack — 70 / 55 / 105 m triangle. Round #1 port, #2 port, #3 starboard. Timing line at #1, parallel to #2–#3. Theoretical line ~325 m, target lap ~30 s @ ~39 km/h.

track.name: SFT - Munich 2026
track.author: Carlos Saez
track.notes:
A parallel race track with both riders starting each from their own gate.

Paths never cross eachother, but leaving strategic wake in front of your opponent is allowed.

Arriving to finish line, precedes with a final 360 loop around RedBull buoys.
